title: Toll Facility Weights for Detours on Wayfare Rides
content:
In a detour toll return on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**, the facility weight follows the toll facility charged on the trip, as the toll charge entry names it.

| Toll facility charged on the trip | Kind | Facility weight |
|---|---|---|
| E-470 | toll road, which a direct route avoids | 1.0 (toll-road weight) |
| Northwest Parkway | toll road, which a direct route avoids | 1.0 (toll-road weight) |
| I-25 Express Lanes | Colorado express lane, which a rider may choose for speed | 0.6 (express-lane weight) |
| US 36 Express Lanes | Colorado express lane | 0.6 (express-lane weight) |
| C-470 Express Lanes | Colorado express lane | 0.6 (express-lane weight) |
| any other facility | — | not changed by the facility |

A toll road (E-470 or the Northwest Parkway), which a direct route avoids, takes the toll-road weight of 1.0; a Colorado express lane (the I-25, US 36 or C-470 express lanes), which a rider may choose for speed, takes the express-lane weight of 0.6; any other facility leaves the facility weight unchanged.

Example (hypothetical): a detoured trip charged for the Northwest Parkway takes 1.0; one charged for the US 36 Express Lanes takes 0.6.
